name: Falla Sagewind
summary: On a crag above the Barrens, Falla Sagewind watches the land for signs of trouble. Her camp lies between the Crossroads and the Lushwater Oasis, where she studies changes in nature and magic.

sections.title: Watcher of the High Crag
sections.body: Falla Sagewind keeps camp on a secluded summit southwest of the Crossroads, high above the Barrens trails. From there, she watches the savanna and the changes in its wildlife. She also studies corruption rising from fissures beneath the Wailing Caverns. Her vigil keeps her apart from the daily trade at the Crossroads, but her attention remains on the spirits and wounds of the land.

sections.title: The Waking Nightmare
sections.body: Strange, pulsing shards taken from mutated beasts in the Wailing Caverns lead travelers to Falla Sagewind. She studies the twisted magic disrupting the oases and recognizes signs that the Emerald Dream has turned foul beneath the earth. For deeper answers about the nightmare taking root in the region, she sends travelers to the wise druids of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.answer: Falla Sagewind watches over the Barrens from her camp on a high cliff southwest of the Crossroads. She helps travelers understand the strange magical afflictions spreading across the region.

faq.q: Where can I find Falla Sagewind?
faq.answer: Falla Sagewind camps atop a mountain peak southwest of the Crossroads and north of the Lushwater Oasis. Rocky paths wind up from the surrounding savanna to her camp.

faq.q: Why is Falla Sagewind interested in the Wailing Caverns?
aliases: why does falla care about the oasis
faq.answer: Falla Sagewind studies strange magic in a glowing shard recovered from the Wailing Caverns. She directs travelers to experienced druids for further counsel.

faq.q: Is Falla Sagewind affiliated with any clan or family?
faq.answer: Falla Sagewind shares her surname with other tauren, but no family connection is confirmed.
Falla Sagewind helps investigate the Wailing Caverns through The Glowing Shard and In Nightmares, which concern the dark dream corrupting the local oases.

faq.q: Can Alliance players interact with Falla Sagewind?
faq.answer: Yes. Falla Sagewind helps travelers of both factions with the Glowing Shard. She sends Alliance adventurers to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus and Horde adventurers to Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren, you may see Falla Sagewind's watch over the earth as quiet stewardship. From high places, she watches for spiritual rot while her brethren defend the roads below.
As a druid, you can follow Falla Sagewind's help in tracing the tragic descent of Naralex and the Druids of the Fang within the Wailing Caverns.
As a member of the Horde, you can turn to Falla Sagewind to interpret strange omens and corrupted relics brought back by scouts from the contested Barrens savannas.
